name: CTAO

formation.locator: ctao.org/about-us/ (describes the CTAO ERIC legal structure but not stated a founding/establishment date)
formation.note: CTAO is legally the CTAO ERIC (European Research Infrastructure Consortium), not a traditional physics 'collaboration' with a formation meeting; no fetched source states when the ERIC was legally established. No formal 'collaboration' entity distinct from the observatory organisation itself was found; this record represents the CTAO Central Organisation.

intervals.label: organisation active
intervals.note: Start date is only a lower bound (the date this session's source was accessed/verified), not a sourced founding date for the CTAO Central Organisation/ERIC.

summary.plain: The international organisation of countries and institutes building and running CTAO, the next-generation gamma-ray observatory.
summary.technical: CTAO Central Organisation (legally the CTAO ERIC), headquartered in Bologna, Italy, with a Science Data Management Centre in Zeuthen, Germany; supported by council members from multiple countries and one intergovernmental organisation per the observatory's own site.

notes: experiment_ids, document_ids deliberately not written (v0.2 A1 derived fields).
host_facility_id/host_site_id left null: CTAO has two co-equal host facilities (Roque de los Muchachos and Paranal), not one primary host, and the schema field takes only one id.

membership counts left null: no fetched source states them in the sense of institution/scientist counts (only 'countries around the globe and one intergovernmental organisation' supporting it, per the homepage).
Leadership left empty: person records are out of scope this wave and none was sourced.
